thread:
marta: Heads-up: onboarding sample-app is triggering a prefetch storm during signup in some envs. Users see a short spike of 429s and duplicated page requests right after the SDK does a token refresh.

sam: saw this in staging too. looks like when auth.refresh happens we re-run the prefetch loop and multiple workers race to fetch the same page cursor. result = N identical `GET /items?cursor=X` in parallel.

lee: quick confirm: this is client-side, right? not the server requeueing?

sam: client-side. logs show prefetch concurrency=6 -> auth refresh -> N concurrent fetches for same cursor -> 429s -> retries that amplify the burst. trimmed trace: ```
[2025-03-18T14:12:00.001Z] prefetch: queue=6 cursor=page_4
[2025-03-18T14:12:00.120Z] auth: start refresh
[2025-03-18T14:12:00.300Z] http 429 GET /items?cursor=page_4 (concurrent=6)
[2025-03-18T14:12:00.450Z] retrying page_4 backoff=100ms
```

dena: workaround: set SAMPLE_PREFETCH=1 in sample-app env while signup flow runs, and add conservative backoff. but that's not great for normal perf.

lee: design idea: add a `prefetchMode` opt-in with modes: "aggressive" (current), "conservative" (for onboarding), and "singleflight" (dedupe fetches). Conservative would set maxConcurrency=2, jitter on start, and pause prefetch while auth.refreshInProgress. Singleflight would dedupe by cursor key + return same promise to callers.

marta: we should also consider parity across SDKs. py/go currently don't expose cursorAffinity flag. this needs to be consistent across clients.

sam: prototype patch I hacked together: ```js
// singleflight map
if (inFlight.has(cursor)) return inFlight.get(cursor)
const promise = fetchPage(cursor, { signal })
inFlight.set(cursor, promise)
promise.finally(()=> inFlight.delete(cursor))
return promise
```

dena: also cancel stale prefetches on newer cursor assignment: use AbortController per fetch and abort if a newer fetch for same cursor starts. reduces wasted throughput.

lee: tests: we need an e2e that simulates token expiry mid-prefetch. CI job should run sample-app with SAMPLE_PREFETCH=4 and force token expiry, assert no more than 1 request per cursor in a 200ms window.

ci-bot: created pipeline job devex/prefetch-token-race-e2e for staging.

marta: Docs/UX: add onboarding caveat and sample env suggestion. For sample-app starter kit, default to prefetchMode="conservative" to avoid new users hitting our rate quotas during signup.

sam: i'll open a PR with cursor singleflight + AbortController + opt-in prefetchMode. will include unit tests for concurrency and an e2e in the new CI job. tagging dx and owners.

lee: one more: add telemetry metric `sdk.prefetch.duplicates` so we can measure before/after. small perf hit but worth it for signal.

marta: agreed. thanks all — follow-up sync tomorrow 11:30 to pick defaults.
